mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.title, LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(e.summary, ''), e.content), 120) AS summary, e.view_count AS viewCount, e.like_count AS likeCount, e.source AS source, e.created_at AS createdAt FROM kb_entry e WHERE e.status = 1 AND (e.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR e.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR e.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) ORDER BY (CASE WHEN e.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 10 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN e.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 3 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN e.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 2 ELSE 0 END + e.like_count * 2 + e.view_count * 0.2) DESC, e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT e.id, e.title, e.summary, e.content, e.source, e.view_count AS viewCount, e.like_count AS likeCount, e.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, e.status, e.created_at AS createdAt FROM kb_entry e WHERE e.status = 1
